show.description: Shruti escapes a forced marriage and impulsively marries Arjun, a seemingly poor tea seller. Unaware he is a billionaire CEO who once loved her from afar, she slowly falls for his sincerity. As love deepens, Arjun’s hidden identity is exposed, breaking her trust. Now, he must prove his love is real not another deal.
